rationale: The candidate is a coherent single bar in all four views, so it avoids the one-view-only failure and the solids-collide issue. However, it remains very close to a generic rectangular extrusion with a shallow roof articulation and almost no public void or threshold response. That makes repair integrity high but program appropriateness only weak: neighborhood living here requires an active street edge, a legible public ground figure, and some hierarchy between grounded public base and calmer upper mass. The visible mass does not yet articulate the verified access edge with a court, notch, undercut, or terrace, so the hard semantic brief is not satisfied. Reference language consistently supports a low-rise bar/courtyard/terrace family, especially when the public void is central or edge-addressed, which the candidate has not yet achieved.
